title: Data Science & Engineering Fellow
description:
About the Organization:Healthy oceans need healthy data systems, and healthy information ecosystems need stewardship. Intertidal Agency empowers ocean data stewards and helps build data infrastructure to drive ocean conservation, management, and innovation. We support the people layer of data sharing with a combination of policy, process, and technical tools. Our multi-disciplinary partners include governments, communities, scientists, nonprofits, and businesses who want to connect ocean data to action by making data more useful, usable, and used.
Position Summary:Intertidal Agency is seeking a data scientist or data engineer for a one-year fellowship to improve data pipelines into the World Ocean Database (WOD), the primary global source for ocean temperature, salinity, oxygen, and nutrient data. The overall project goal is to make WOD data more FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) by standardizing workflows for data ingestion across a global community of data contributors. A specific focus for the fellow will be developing algorithmic solutions for de-duplicating data submissions from uncrewed systems, such as gliders, and expanding those solutions to address other ocean and earth science problems. Addressing this problem will require contending with three intersecting issues:
• Identification. How do you determine that two records describe the same observation? The obvious matching key for glider data is unreliable, and finding better ones is part of the work.
• Survivorship. Once duplicates are identified, which copy survives, and on what basis? Later submissions are often better, but not always. The rule must be defensible and documented.
• Granularity. A glider may report every second. WOD cannot absorb that resolution across a growing fleet, and binning decisions determine what future researchers can ask of the record. Setting a community standard for granularity takes both analysis and community agreement.
Developing and publishing rigorous, community-supported solutions to these issues will be a significant contribution to WOD and the broader earth science field.
This is a one-year, fixed-term position that is supported by a Climate Reserve fellowship, and the hire will also participate in Climate Reserve network activities.
## Primary Responsibilities
• Establish and help manage a project advisory committee ocean data professionals.
• Work directly with the major glider data providers (e.g. IOOS, EGO, and IMOS) on upstream improvements to data submissions.
• Develop, test, and document an algorithmic method for identifying duplicate observations from gliders and other autonomous platforms, and for selecting which record to retain. Benchmark against the publicly served California Underwater Glider Network Line 80 record, roughly 67,000 quality-controlled profiles spanning 2005 to the present, then work against NOAA NCEI’s glider holdings.
• Convene and run working sessions, including hackathons, to collaboratively develop solutions. Participants would include people experienced with the data sources, research software engineers, data scientists, and WOD experts. Support workshop participants in implementing and iterating on workshop products within their own workflows.
• Release all code, computational notebooks, and documentation publicly under open licenses, written so that other data centers can adopt the methods. Prepare a manuscript for a peer-reviewed journal with the fellow as lead author.
• Work with project directors and the advisory committee to draft recommendations for the Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission (IOC) to support the new standards and workflows. These would be drafted during the fellowship and presented at the fall 2028 IOC meeting.
## The Ideal Candidate
You are drawn to challenges that span disciplines. You can take a messy, real-world data problem and find structure in it. You write code other people can run and read. You work well with people with a wide range of technical fluency, from research software engineers to program managers and scientists. You have experience modernizing legacy data systems. You develop clear roadmaps and roles with your teammates that let you work independently while staying coordinated. You see AI as a tool to support human expertise and judgement, not a replacement.
You do not need to be an oceanographer. If you bring strong quantitative and data science skills, the project leads and advisors will provide the ocean science grounding.
Specific Experience Requested:We recognize that each applicant for this role will bring unique skills, knowledge, experiences, and background to this position. We welcome diverse experiences and perspectives in our applicant pool, and will be looking for candidates who possess many, but not necessarily all, of the following qualifications and experience:
• Quantitative and algorithmic capability. Multivariate statistics and dimensionality reduction, similarity and distance metrics, clustering or classification. Experience with record linkage, entity resolution, fuzzy matching, or deduplication in any domain, including outside Earth science (e.g. bibliographic records, customer data, other sensor networks).
• Working knowledge of why pairwise comparison across millions of records is not viable, and familiarity with blocking, indexing, approximate nearest neighbor search, or locality-sensitive hashing as ways around it.
• Python fluency, preferably with numpy, pandas, and scipy. Version control with git.
• Comfortable in a Unix or Linux shell on a remote machine, with pipes, regular expressions, and standard text processing tools. You will need to open an unfamiliar file, inspect it, and write something to interrogate it, with nobody available to walk you through it.
• Reading and writing netCDF, including CF conventions, standard names, fill values, and time units. The majority of the data under consideration will be in this format. Familiarity with CF discrete sampling geometries, particularly Profile and TrajectoryProfile, is a strong plus, since that is how glider deployments are represented.
• Retrieving data programmatically from ERDDAP, THREDDS, or OPeNDAP endpoints, and from federal repositories, university archives, and cloud object storage.
• Independence. The ability to take an ambiguous problem, break it apart, and make progress without close supervision.
• Experience handling data you did not collect, from providers you do not control, in formats you did not choose
• Experience with government data infrastructure and modernizing legacy data systems
• International research or data collaboration
• Familiarity with oceanographic or earth science data
## Workplace & Compensation
Workplace: Intertidal Agency has a fully remote workforce with a 32 hour work week. The fellow will be expected to be available during a core set of working hours (generally 0900-1300 Pacific Time) with some availability during UTC/Europe time.
Travel: Estimated three weeks of travel for two project workshops plus the annual Climate Reserve convening.
Compensation: Intertidal Agency and Multiplier provide a comprehensive compensation package, including competitive salary ($78k-$88k annual salary), excellent medical and dental benefits, retirement savings, and generous vacation and sick leave policy.
How to Apply: To apply, please visit our Applicant Portal. Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. Priority will be given to applications received on or before Sunday, November 29, 2026. Please include your resume and a cover letter explaining your interest in the role. We respectfully request no follow-up calls or emails.
Intertidal Agency is an independent operating project ofMultiplier, a nationally recognized nonprofit that accelerates impact for sustainability-focused initiatives.
Multiplier is committed to creating an inclusive, equitable, and accessible application process for all candidates. We recognize that the traditional hiring process can create barriers. If we can support your participation in the job application or interview process by providing specific assistance or accommodation, please reach out to . Requests for accommodations are confidential and will not impact your candidacy.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is an opportunity to contribute to technology initiatives in a collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth.
## Job Title: Machine Learning Engineer
## Location: Remote
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2 - [Not open to C2C or 1099]
## Salary Range: $115,000–$165,000 Annually
## Experience Required: 8+ years
Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card holders, EAD holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. Bright Vision Technologies is unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.
## Job Summary
Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to develop, train, evaluate, and operationalize predictive and classification models for production applications. The engineer will work across data preparation, feature engineering, model experimentation, validation, and deployment, partnering with data scientists and software teams to deliver measurable model performance and maintainable services.
## Key Responsibilities
Prepare datasets, engineer features, and build reproducible training and validation pipelines.
Develop, tune, and evaluate machine learning models for classification, regression, ranking, or forecasting use cases.
Implement model-serving components and integrate inference workflows with application and data platforms.
Track model performance, investigate drift or quality degradation, and recommend retraining or improvement actions.
Document experiments, model assumptions, evaluation results, and implementation decisions for engineering stakeholders.
## Required Qualifications
Experience Required: typically 8+ years in machine learning engineering, applied data science, or related production model development; align with the approved requisition.
Strong Python skills and practical experience with libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, or equivalent tools.
Understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, feature engineering, and statistical fundamentals.
Experience with at least one deep-learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, where relevant to the project.
Experience building reproducible data and model pipelines and managing code through Git.
Ability to deploy or integrate model inference into APIs, batch workflows, or application services.
Strong analytical reasoning, experimentation discipline, and communication of model trade-offs.
Experience working in iterative software delivery teams, participating in planning, defect triage, and release validation as appropriate to the assignment.
## Preferred Qualifications
Experience with distributed training, feature stores, experiment tracking, or model registries.
Exposure to cloud machine learning services and containerized deployment.
Familiarity with model explainability, bias evaluation, and production monitoring practices.
Relevant machine learning or cloud platform certification.
## How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact Jennifer at (908) 505-3544. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

description:
## Location:Remote
## Who We Are
All Star Healthcare Solutions is one of the nation's fastest-growing locum tenens healthcare staffing firms, proudly serving Providers, Clients, and the Community with excellence. Headquartered in Boca Raton, FL, we offer a professional, fast-paced environment that is collaborative, innovative, and never overly corporate.
We recruit, credential, license and place physicians and advanced practice providers with hospitals and health systems in every state, an we support the full lifecycle of that relationship.
As a Sun-Sentinel Top Places to Work recipient, we invest in our people—their personal, professional, and financial goals—while fostering a culture built on teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement. If you're looking for the opportunity to influence executive strategy, lead transformational initiatives, and help shape the future of a growing organization, All Star is the place to build your career.
## What You Will Do
All Star Healthcare Solutions is seeking an experienced AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy AI capabilities across the enterprise. This position reports to the Chief Information Officer and works alongside the Salesforce Architect and Platform Owner, Salesforce Engineers, Salesforce Administrator, Analytics Engineer, and the Project Manager/Business Analyst on a single flat technology team. This position builds production AI solutions — agents, automations, and model-backed features — on the Salesforce Platform, on Microsoft 365, and against the enterprise data warehouse, This role also defines the guardrails those solutions operate within. This position combines hands-on engineering with the judgment to say when a use case is not ready to automate.
## Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
## You Will Own the Following:
• Design, build, test, and deploy AI solutions end to end — agents, assistants, retrieval pipelines, classification and extraction services, and model-backed automations
• Build Agentforce agents on the Salesforce Platform — topic and action design, grounding, prompt templates, testing, and release
• Build and support AI capabilities on Microsoft 365 and Claude Enterprise, including custom integrations, MCP servers, and internal tooling
• Engineer the retrieval and grounding layer against enterprise data — source selection, chunking, embedding, indexing, and relevance evaluation
• Define and implement AI guardrails — data access scoping, encryption, PII and PHI handling, prompt injection defense, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and audit logging
• Build evaluation harnesses and regression suites for AI features; measure accuracy, latency, cost per task, and failure modes before and after release
• Instrument deployed AI in production — usage, cost, error, and quality monitoring — and act on what the telemetry shows
• Document solution design, data flows, model and tool selection, and operating procedures for every deployed capability
• Support adoption — enablement material, office hours, and feedback loops with the business users of deployed AI
• Track the AI and platform vendor roadmaps and evaluate new capability against what has already been built
## Required Education and Experience

• Producing concise summaries of longer pieces of text or data.

AI can write code now. It can't decide what's worth building, and it can't tell whether its own output is right. That part is yours. What you build lands with many companies working to keep their data, and the people behind it, safe.

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

Own what you build, end to end. Shape capabilities in discovery with your Product Owner and Designer, build them across frontend and backend, ship them to production, and make sure they work properly in customers' hands.
Help decide what gets built, not just how. Challenge assumptions, suggest alternatives, and help define requirements before anyone writes code.
Engineer with AI, responsibly. Use agentic workflows and AI tooling every day while you stay accountable for architecture, security and quality. You'll also help shape how our team builds with AI.
Build the new and improve the existing. Your time splits roughly evenly between new product capabilities and modernising an established codebase. Every area you touch should be better when you leave it.
Work beyond your team's walls. Spot dependencies with our other teams early, raise risks before they block delivery, and keep stakeholders informed.
Deliver as a team. Join four talented engineers who share ownership. You'll work in four-month terms with two-week sprints, keep rituals lean, and adjust scope when reality changes.
## WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN
The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world
Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs
Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market
Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget
Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.
## THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD
You think in problems, solutions and how to implement them properly to deliver value to customers, not tickets that should to be done.
You're a builder across the stack, with at least 3 years of professional software engineering experience. You've shipped features on both frontend and backend. Your backend are Java, Node.js using typescript or a similar typed languages, a knowledge in ruby is a plus. Your frontend is a modern SPA framework: Vue is ideal and React works too. You don't need deep expertise in both, but you can deliver on each without help.
You treat Product and Design as partners. You've worked closely with Product Managers and Designers. You've disagreed with one, and the result was a better idea.
Ambiguity doesn't stop you. You don't wait for a perfect ticket. You ask the right questions, make a call, write it down and move forward.
You use AI seriously, but not blindly. You've built real workflows with AI tools and you know how to verify what they produce through reviews, tests and asking "is this actually right?" You don't vibe-code your way to production.
You fix what's broken, deliberately. You won't ignore an issue just because it sits outside your ticket. You also know which ones to fix now, which to flag for later, and which rabbit holes to stay out of.
You explain things clearly. You can describe a technical decision in plain English to a customer, a colleague from Sales or Support, or a fellow engineer. You've worked in more than one company or product and you bring what you learned.
LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS:
No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. title: AI & Data Platform Engineer (GCP) (all levels)
description:
## Über KnowWay
KnowWay entwickelt KI-Agenten für kritische Infrastruktur: Energie, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Sektor. Wir automatisieren Geschäftsprozesse mit autonomen Agenten, und zwar für Kunden, bei denen Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datensouveränität Pflicht sind.
Wir begleiten unsere Kunden über den gesamten Daten- und KI-Lebenszyklus. Wir sammeln und speichern die Daten, verarbeiten sie mit und für KI, sichern ihre Qualität und integrieren die Ergebnisse in produktive Systeme.
## Das Projekt
Für einen führenden Telekommunikationskonzern in Deutschland setzen wir Daten- und KI-Projekte auf der Google Cloud um. Wir kennen die gesamte Prozess- und Systemlandschaft des Kunden, arbeiten darin und bauen mehrere Plattformen, auf denen die Fachbereiche ihre Anwendungsfälle betreiben. Mehrere Anwendungsfälle laufen parallel und stehen an unterschiedlichen Punkten zwischen Discovery und Live-Betrieb.
Unser Delivery-Team deckt dabei ungewöhnlich viel ab: Business-Analyse und die Definition der eigentlichen Anforderungen, Solution Design, schnelle PoCs und die Produktivsetzung. Wo es passt, verwenden wir vorhandene Plattform-Capabilities wieder, und wo etwas fehlt, entwickeln wir es neu.
Der Stack läuft bereits produktiv. Dazu gehören LLM-Extraktionspipelines über einen gemanagten AI-Service mit vorgeschaltetem Compliance-Proxy, agentische Systeme mit Vector Search, Batch-Verarbeitung und Orchestrierung, ein zentrales Data Warehouse und containerisierte Services. Die Infrastruktur ist komplett als Code beschrieben und läuft in einer streng abgeschotteten Umgebung mit mehreren Freigabestufen. Auf der Roadmap stehen unter anderem der Umbau des Query-Layers, die Anbindung von On-Premise-Systemen an Cloud-Worker und die Integration weiterer Quellsysteme.
## Die Rolle
Du arbeitest mit uns dort, wo Datenpipelines, KI-Modelle und Cloud-Infrastruktur zusammenkommen. Gemeinsam mit dem Team sorgst Du dafür, dass das Ergebnis im Produktivbetrieb zuverlässig läuft, und übernimmst dabei nach und nach mehr Verantwortung. Jeder Schritt soll nachvollziehbar, überwacht und wartbar bleiben, auch wenn sich Datenmengen, Dokumentqualität oder Anforderungen ändern.
## Zwei Wege in diese Rolle
Der Stack reicht von der Infrastruktur über Datenpipelines bis zu LLM- und Agentensystemen. Niemand bringt das alles auf Expertenniveau mit, deshalb beschreiben wir zwei Profile mit jeweils anderen Entwicklungsperspektiven. Wenn Du einen Schwerpunkt und die Bereitschaft hast, auch in die andere Richtung mitzudenken, dann ist die Rolle die Richtige für Dich.
Profil A - Platform-Schwerpunkt: Deine Erfahrung liegt vor allem in GCP/Cloud-Infrastruktur, Infrastructure as Code und Deployment. Daten- und AI-Pipelines willst Du so weit verstehen, dass Du sie betreiben und debuggen kannst.
Profil B - AI & Data-Schwerpunkt: Deine Erfahrung liegt vor allem in AI Engineering, LLM- und Datenpipelines und in Datenmodellierung. Die Infrastruktur darunter willst Du so weit verstehen, dass Du selbst deployen und Probleme bis in die Plattform verfolgen kannst.
In der Rolle entwickelst Du Dich jeweils in die andere Richtung: Mit Profil A arbeitest Du Dich zunehmend in AI- und Datenthemen ein, mit Profil B in Infrastruktur und Plattform. Wir planen das bewusst ein, und Du übernimmst auf der anderen Seite nach und nach mehr Aufgaben.
Die Rolle passt auch für Junior- und Mid-Level-Engineers. Wichtiger als viele Jahre Erfahrung ist uns, dass Du in einem der beiden Bereiche schon praktisch gearbeitet hast und Lust hast, Dich in den anderen einzuarbeiten. Die Anforderungen unten "für beide Profile“ + das A oder B-Profil sind das Minimum, mit dem Du einsteigen kannst. Wer mehr mitbringt, steigt entsprechend höher ein.
## Deine Aufgaben
Die Listen beschreiben das Spektrum des Teams. Wie viel davon Du am Anfang übernimmst, hängt von Deiner Erfahrung ab.
## Gemeinsamer Kern:
Entwicklung und Betrieb von Datenpipelines auf GCP: Batch-Verarbeitung, Orchestrierung, Beladung der Datenplattform
Anbindung neuer Datenquellen. Jede Quelle hat ihre eigenen Eigenheiten, deshalb lässt sich eine Anbindung selten einfach auf die nächste übertragen.
Fehlersuche über die gesamte Kette, von der Quelldatei über Pipeline und Modell bis in die Anwendung
Zusammenarbeit mit den Plattform-Teams des Kunden und Begleitung der technischen Freigabeprozesse
Enge Abstimmung mit unserem Solution Architect zu Datenmodell und Architektur
## Schwerpunkt Platform:
Aufbau und Pflege der Infrastruktur mit Terraform, über mehrere Umgebungen und Freigabestufen
CI/CD-Pipelines, Deployment-Automatisierung, Container-Builds und Vulnerability-Gates
Netzwerk, IAM, Secret-Management, Verschlüsselung und Zugriffskonzepte
Logging, Monitoring und Alerting für Pipelines und Anwendungen
Kostenkontrolle und Ressourcendimensionierung
## Schwerpunkt AI & Data:
Entwicklung von LLM-Extraktionspipelines: Segmentierung und Klassifikation von Dokumenten, prompt-basierte Extraktion, Schema-Validierung, Upsert in die Datenplattform
Extraktionsgenauigkeit bewerten und verbessern, auf Basis belastbarer Messungen
Agentische Systeme und RAG: Multi-Agent-Architekturen, Embeddings, Vector Search, Evaluierung von Tool-Auswahl und Antwortqualität
Datenmodellierung und Migration: Schema-Design, Historisierung, Umbau des Query-Layers von BigQuery nach Postgres
Datenqualität als eigenes Arbeitsfeld
## Was Du mitbringst
## Für beide Profile:
Mindestens etwa ein Jahr Berufserfahrung mit Datenpipelines, Cloud-Infrastruktur oder KI-Systemen. Eine längere Werkstudententätigkeit in einem Engineering-Team zählt auch. Idealerweise lief davon schon etwas in Produktion und nicht nur in Notebooks oder Proof-of-Concepts.
Gute Python-Kenntnisse und solides SQL.
Erfahrung mit GCP oder einer anderen Cloud wie AWS oder Azure. Kommst Du nicht von GCP, traust Du Dir zu, Dein Wissen schnell zu übertragen.
Du arbeitest mit Git und Code Review und hast CI/CD schon in der Praxis genutzt.
Du bleibst an einem Problem dran, bis Du verstehst, was passiert, auch wenn die Ursache drei Systemgrenzen weiter liegt.
Deutsch und Englisch mindestens fließend. Unser Team arbeitet in beiden Sprachen, die Dokumentation der Fachbereiche ist auf Deutsch.
## Profil A (Platform): In mehreren dieser Punkte hast Du schon Erfahrung:
Terraform oder ein vergleichbares IaC-Werkzeug
GCP-Kernservices oder ihre Pendants bei anderen Clouds: Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, IAM, Networking, Secret Management
CI/CD-Pipelines und Container-Builds
Logging, Monitoring und Alerting in der Cloud
Interesse an Daten- und AI-Pipelines: Du willst lernen, sie zu betreiben, zu debuggen und zu erweitern
## Profil B (AI & Data): In mehreren dieser Punkte hast Du schon Erfahrung:
LLM-Anwendungen gebaut, etwa für Extraktion aus unstrukturierten Dokumenten, mit strukturierten Ausgaben, Schema-Validierung und Prompt-Design
Du kennst die Grenzen von LLMs, etwa Nicht-Determinismus, Halluzination und Datenqualität als limitierenden Faktor, und Du misst die Genauigkeit Deiner Ergebnisse.
Datenpipelines und Datenmodellierung: BigQuery oder ein vergleichbares Warehouse, Orchestrierung, Schema-Design
Interesse an der Infrastruktur darunter: Du willst lernen, selbst zu deployen und Probleme bis in die Plattform zu verfolgen
## Nice-to-have:
Erfahrung mit Gemini/Vertex AI, Document AI oder vergleichbaren Cloud-AI-Diensten
Erfahrung mit Agenten-Frameworks (Google ADK, LangChain o. Ä.), Vector Search und RAG-Evaluierung
Erfahrung mit Dataflow/Apache Beam, Composer/Airflow oder Kubeflow/KFP
Erfahrung mit Data-Warehouse-Migrationen und Historisierungsmustern (SCD-2)
Erfahrung mit Django/DRF
Erfahrung mit OCR-Verarbeitung und schwankender Dokumentenqualität
Erfahrung in regulierten oder governance-lastigen Enterprise-Umgebungen, etwa mit Security-Assessments, Datenschutz-Prüfungen und Verschlüsselungskonzepten
Du setzt AI-Coding-Tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot o. Ä.) aktiv ein und hast einen eigenen Workflow, mit dem Du ihre Ergebnisse prüfst
Branchenkenntnisse in Telekommunikation, Infrastruktur oder Rechnungsprüfung
## Wie wir Dich einarbeiten
Du bekommst eine feste Ansprechperson im Team und startest mit einem abgegrenzten Teil, zum Beispiel einer Pipeline oder einem Modul. Code Reviews und Pairing mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen sind dabei Dein wichtigster Lernweg.
## So arbeiten wir mit KI
Wir versuchen, KI in jedes Asset einzubauen, an dem wir arbeiten. Dabei prüfen wir jedes Mal, wo sie hilft, ob sie überhaupt hilft, ob ihr Einsatz compliant ist und wie man sie richtig einsetzt. Das gehört bei uns zur täglichen Routine und sollte auch zu Deiner werden.
## Was wir bieten
Gehalt zwischen 60.000 und 80.000 Euro brutto im Jahr, je nach Erfahrung
Erfolgsbeteiligung
Betriebliche Weiterbildung
Firmenevents und Company Offsites
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice
Ein Stack, der in Produktion läuft und den Du substanziell weiterentwickeln kannst, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten
## Standort
Du arbeitest überwiegend im Homeoffice. Einmal pro Woche treffen wir uns als Team im Ruhrgebiet, im Wechsel in Duisburg und Dortmund, und einmal im Monat beim Kunden in Düsseldorf. Damit das gut machbar bleibt, sollte Dein Wohnort höchstens etwa 1,5 Stunden Fahrzeit von Dortmund oder Duisburg entfernt sein.

title: AI Enablement Engineer
description:
AI doesn't run in one place anymore. It runs in the browser tab, the desktop app, the agent your engineers kicked off, and the copilot embedded in the tools you already pay for. Harmonic Security governs all of it.
Our AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform sits on the device, inside the interaction, at the moment of action, reading what AI is actually doing (not just the traffic around it) and acting in real time. Security teams get full visibility and control across every AI surface, including the agentic and MCP layer that traditional tools can't see. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.
We're gaining serious traction at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.
## How We Work: AI-First by Design
Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively leverages AI tools to perform their best work, from deep research and writing to building robust processes and automating complex workflows. We expect every new hire to bring a genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to using it to work smarter, faster, and with greater creativity.
For some, this involves tinkering and remaining open to emerging tools; for others, it means architecting entirely new systems with AI at the core. We will be transparent about expectations for every role and provide the tools and support needed for you to thrive.
## About the Team
Our Product Delivery team is the engine that turns vision into impact. We ship early and often, getting valuable features into the hands of customers quickly and iterating from there. We work in the open by default, sharing progress and ideas, and we trust each other to own outcomes. We’re a small but mighty crew where every person plays a critical role and we’re committed to using AI to work smarter and faster.
## About the Role
We're looking for an AI Enablement Engineer to join the Platform team in Product Delivery. You'll own the AI tooling our engineers use every day to design, build, review and ship software.
Our engineers share a common AI coding setup, including skills, plugins, MCP tools and conventions, so an improvement one person makes reaches everyone. You'll run that setup and keep making it better. That means building agents that take on parts of how we deliver, such as code review, and turning the corrections engineers make again and again into skills, hooks and automated checks.
## What You'll Do
Own the shared AI coding setup and internal plugin marketplace, including skills, hooks, MCP tools, settings and safe access
Own our AI-driven development lifecycle and build agents for tasks such as code review
Use telemetry and engineer feedback to spot recurring problems and fix them in skills, plugins or deterministic checks
Own evaluations that show whether changes to skills and agents make them better
Work with engineers across disciplines to build useful tooling, assess new harness and model features, and retire what isn't used
Own the docs and onboarding that help engineers use the tooling effectively
## What You Bring
A genuine passion for AI coding tools and agents, with hands-on experience building and maintaining skills, plugins, MCP integrations and other tooling that helps engineers get more from their tools and automates real work.
Hands-on software engineering experience, shipping and maintaining code that others depend on
Experience configuring, rolling out and maintaining shared developer tools, including safe handling of access, secrets and sensitive data
Experience deploying and managing Agents that improve the software delivery lifecycle
Strong scripting and automation skills, plus experience with Git, CI/CD and developer tooling
Experience evaluating AI workflows against real examples, understanding failure modes and improving results
Clear writing and collaboration skills, and comfort navigating a polyglot stack: Java, React and TypeScript, Python and Terraform on AWS
## You Might Be a Fit if You
Fix the cause when you find yourself correcting the same thing twice, and prefer deterministic checks where possible
Care about developer experience and check whether a tool actually saves time
Enjoy helping colleagues get more from their tools through pairing, demos and docs
Thrive in fast-paced startup environments where ambiguity is the norm
## Why Join Us
This isn't just a job - it's a chance to help define a category. Harmonic Security was named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, and we're just getting started. We're building at the intersection of AI and security, carving out an emerging market where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.
We believe today's talent is tomorrow's success, and we're committed to creating an environment where you can do the best work of your life.
Recognized momentum - We made the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, a signal that the market is taking notice
Rare market opportunity - Join early in a category-defining company at the convergence of AI and security, where your work directly shapes how enterprises tackle one of the biggest unsolved problems in tech
Competitive pay and meaningful equity - A real stake in Harmonic's success, not a token gesture
Comprehensive benefits - pension plan and flexible hybrid work
A small, high-trust team that values transparency, creativity, and continuous learning - no politics, no bureaucracy
Thoughtful leadership - that cares deeply about your growth, not just your output
Annual global off-sites - past trips include Lisbon, Portugal and Nashville, TN
Real ownership - you'll shape the product, the culture, and the direction of the company from day one
## Harmonic's Core Values

We embrace new, unfamiliar situations that require initiative and rapid decision-making. We orient ourselves quickly and deliver results with minimal guidance.

We raise our hands, take on challenges, and assist others whenever possible. We hunger for opportunities to learn and do more.

description:

➡️ Can you combine hands-on technical capability with the confidence to engage enterprise customers, understand their challenges and design solutions that deliver real value?
If this sounds like your next move, we’d love to hear from you.
## Role Summary:
We have an exciting new role as an AI Solutions Engineer to support our R&D customers.
You’ll work alongside Account Executives and Account Managers throughout the sales process, speaking directly with prospective customers to understand their R&D and data workflows, uncover what they’re trying to achieve, and design AI-powered solutions around those needs. This isn’t a role where you simply demo an existing product. You’ll be expected to build and tailor the solution for the customer — using Patsnap’s data, APIs, MCP capabilities and AI tools to create agents, workflows, prototypes and proof-of-concepts that bring their use case to life.
The brief is simple:
Understand the customer. Build the solution. Prove the value.
We’re looking for people who can bring together:
Domain knowledge + customer-facing experience + real AI build capability
A typical day could involve joining several customer calls, running technical discovery, building a prototype between meetings, demonstrating it live to a prospect, refining it based on feedback and, where needed, supporting deployment after signature.
We're looking for someone who brings together three core strengths:
R&D & Engineering Workflow Understanding: You understand how R&D, engineering and innovation teams operate, the challenges they face and where AI can deliver value.
Customer-Facing & Commercial Capability: You're confident engaging enterprise customers, leading technical discovery and translating requirements into compelling solutions.
Hands-On AI Development: You can independently build AI agents, integrations, automated workflows and technical prototypes, rather than simply demonstrating existing software.
You'll use Patsnap's proprietary R&D and innovation intelligence, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) capabilities and AI technologies to design, build and demonstrate solutions tailored to customer needs.
That could involve developing an AI agent to accelerate technical research, integrating Patsnap's intelligence into existing enterprise systems, automating technology scouting processes or creating intelligent workflows to support engineering and product development decisions.
You'll take customer challenges from initial discovery through to working prototypes and proof-of-concepts, demonstrating how AI can deliver meaningful improvements to their R&D processes.
This is not a traditional software engineering role. You won’t be expected to build production software from scratch, but you will need to be technically confident, comfortable building independently and credible in front of enterprise customers.
Want to see the platform you'd be representing?
Check out this short overview:

Build with AI every day. Design and develop AI agents, technical workflows, integrations and prototypes that address real customer challenges.
Work at the forefront of R&D innovation. Help leading organisations transform how they approach research, technology discovery, engineering and product development.
Go beyond traditional pre-sales. You'll have the freedom to design and build tailored solutions rather than simply demonstrate existing software.

Business or Product Analyst

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
At Signal AI, we use cutting-edge AI technology to offer clarity on decisions that shape businesses and society. We value restless curiosity, creative thinking, and diverse perspectives as we strive to become AI-native. We believe that AI is a collaborator, not just a tool, and we invite passionate individuals to join us on our journey as we continue to learn, experiment, and grow together.
We're hiring a Senior SRE to help us run and evolve the infrastructure behind Signal AI's decision intelligence platform.
You'd be joining a small, collaborative Infrastructure team at a moment when the work is genuinely changing shape. Over the last year, we've hardened the platform, reduced cost, and built serious observability into our highest-volume systems. The next year is about scaling that work, absorbing infrastructure from a recent acquisition, and being thoughtful about how AI shows up in operational work: not as a gimmick, but as a tool we trust ourselves to use well.
We're looking for someone who wants to shape the team's direction; someone people can rely on for tricky or urgent problems; someone who brings curiosity and care to the work; and someone who wants to leave things meaningfully better than they found them.
## What we've shipped recently
Cut ~$50k/year off our Elasticsearch bill by migrating compute to more efficient chips. (Apr 2026)
Built the foundation for our MCP server platform: leveraging and contributing to open-source tooling to give the whole company extensible, production-grade AI integrations. (2025–2026)
Rebuilt production from scratch in a full DR game day. End-to-end restore validated across our multi-account AWS setup. (Jan 2026)
## What we're working on next
AI-augmented operations: Claude Enterprise is deployed across Signal. We want this team to help define what good looks like for SRE: incident triage, runbook generation, capacity planning, cost analysis. This is a strategic investment, not a side project, and we'd love someone genuinely curious about what these tools can and can't do.
Security in the age of AI: The threat landscape has shifted. Supply chain security is more at threat than ever, and powerful models are emerging that promise to change how the industry thinks about security. We're looking for someone interested in thinking seriously about what actually matters to protect now.
Acquisition integration: Bringing a recently acquired product's infrastructure under our reliability, security, and operational standards. A substantial, multi-quarter piece of work with real technical and organisational complexity, and plenty of room to make your mark.
Batch workload consolidation: Moving disparate batch jobs onto EKS for unified scheduling, cost visibility, and operational tooling.
## Your first six months
We want to set you up to thrive. Here's what that looks like in practice:
Month 1: You're onboarded across our AWS estate, Terraform, and observability stack. You've completed your first on-call shift with team support, landed your first PR in the DevOps repo, and started working Claude Enterprise into your daily flow.
Month 3: You're owning a workstream end-to-end. You've led the SRE response to at least one production incident and hosted your first post-mortem. You've surfaced a real opportunity and pushed it to a measurable result.
Month 6: You're driving a multi-quarter workstream with clear direction, coaching less experienced teammates along the way, and contributing insights to our AI-in-operations playbook: including where Claude adds real leverage and where it doesn't.
## What we're looking for
You have solid AWS and Terraform experience, and you're comfortable writing Python or Go to solve operational problems. You think in distributed systems: failure modes, observability, blast radius: and you take problems end-to-end rather than stopping at the edges of your own work.
When a problem is complex, you can lay out a few ways to solve it, weigh the trade-offs, and recommend the one that meets our needs now without sacrificing tomorrow. You take personal ownership of customer-impacting issues in the systems you look after.
You communicate openly and you're comfortable pushing back when you think something could be better. You give clear, actionable feedback and you enjoy helping others level up.
You're pragmatic about AI tooling. Not evangelical, not dismissive. You can tell us when you'd reach for an LLM and when you wouldn't, and you'd have a clear reason either way.
We know not every strong candidate will have every skill on this list. If you're excited about the work and you're close on the experience, we'd encourage you to apply.
## Nice to haves
Networking depth. You're comfortable below the load balancer: TCP/IP fundamentals, DNS, VPC design, and what actually happens when a service can't reach another one.
Operational security instincts. You follow the threat landscape with genuine interest: not just CVEs, but shifts in how attacks happen and how the industry is responding. You have a point of view on what actually matters right now.
Linux internals comfort. When something behaves strangely under load, you know where to look.
Elasticsearch at scale. Sharding, index lifecycle management, node failures and JVM tuning.
Communication across technical levels. You can collaborate with your infrastructure teammates and explain the same concepts clearly to a product manager.
Not sure you meet every requirement? Studies show that women and other underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they check every box. At Signal AI, diverse perspectives strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and lead to better performance. So even if your background doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we encourage you to apply if you’re passionate about this role.
We're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every Signaller feels welcomed, valued, and heard—a place where you can truly thrive as yourself.
Compensation: £75K – £95K

title: AI & Data Engineer
description:
## AI & Data Engineer
Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time
## About Us
Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.
We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.
## The Role
We're looking for a polyglot engineer who is comfortable across the data stack. This is someone who can build AI-powered tools and data infrastructure that make our platform smarter, our people more effective, and our operations more scalable.
This is not a research role. You'll build real systems that people use every day — Slack bots that investigate production incidents, data pipelines that surface anomalies before clients notice them, and AI agents that turn hours of manual trawling into seconds of guided investigation. You'll work across the full stack: Python and TypeScript for AI tooling and integrations, Go for backend services, and SQL for data analysis and pipeline work.
The person we're looking for ships working software, cares about making people's lives easier, and is energised by the pace of the AI landscape. You don't need to have built LLM applications before — but you should be curious, practical, and comfortable learning fast.
You'll work closely with our TechOps, Connectivity, and Data teams to understand their workflows, pain points, and knowledge gaps — then build the tools and infrastructure that solve them. This is a high-leverage role: the systems you build will multiply the effectiveness of every engineer and operator in the company.
## What You'll Work On
AI-powered investigation tools — Slack-based bots and agents that automatically analyse support tickets, query production logs, and surface relevant context for incident response
MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers — authenticated access to ClickHouse, Kubernetes, Atlassian, and GitHub, enabling AI agents to interact with real systems safely
Data infrastructure — ClickHouse analytics pipelines, real-time anomaly detection, and platform health monitoring (our "Radar" initiative)
AI agent development — constrained, repeatable diagnosis agents that follow investigation playbooks, produce structured outputs, and operate with appropriate guardrails
Knowledge engineering — building and curating the corpus that makes our AI tools accurate: documentation, training material, structured metadata, and feedback loops
Internal tooling — full-stack applications that bridge the gap between data, AI, and the people who need answers
## What We Need
Technical:
Strong Python — your primary language for AI tooling, data pipelines, and backend services
Systems design – you have extensive experience building data-intensive systems. You can consider tradeoffs and manage system complexity
TypeScript / JavaScript — for Slack integrations, web interfaces, and full-stack tooling
Go experience is a bonus — we use Go extensively for backend services and CLI tooling
SQL — comfortable writing analytical queries against large datasets (ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, or similar)
Familiarity with LLM APIs and tooling — Claude, OpenAI, or similar; prompt engineering, function calling, tool use
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS — your tools will run in production infrastructure
Git and Linux fundamentals
Experience in financial services is a plus but not essential — domain knowledge can be learned; engineering instinct cannot
How you work:
You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate quickly, you get things in front of users, you improve based on feedback
You bridge domains. You're comfortable moving between AI, data, infrastructure, and product. You don't wait for someone else to define the interface — you go and understand the problem yourself
You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You monitor it, you fix it, you make it better
You write things down. Documentation is how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. Good documentation also makes our AI tools better — every well-written page becomes training material
You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication is essential
You embrace AI as a tool. You use AI to amplify your own productivity — and you build tools that do the same for others
## What You Get
Growth — this role sits at the intersection of AI, data, and platform engineering. As the company scales, so does the opportunity. This is a new pod with an exciting remit
Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver
Greenfield AI work — you're not maintaining legacy systems; you're building the next generation of intelligent tooling for a trading platform
Real impact — the tools you build will be used daily by engineers, operators, and eventually clients. This is not a side project
An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards
Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our people
Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites
Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp
We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.
## Our Hiring Process
We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.
Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes
Stage 2: Technical Interview with a member of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session. ~60 minutes
Stage 3: Leadership Conversation with our CTO
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes
What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.
## How to Apply
Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.
Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.
Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.
Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.
Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

title: STAGE - Junior Fullstack Engineer - Jobexit
description:
Notre mission ⚖️
Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.
Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.
Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.
Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.
Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.
Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.
Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.
## Sujet de stage
Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage.
Dans un litige, un salarié peut demander plusieurs choses à la fois : des salaires impayés, une indemnité de licenciement, des dommages et intérêts, etc. L'objectif du stage est de permettre à l'utilisateur de saisir et d'organiser toutes ces demandes dans l'application, pour mieux estimer les montants en jeu, préparer la négociation avec la partie adverse et générer automatiquement le récapitulatif final destiné au juge. Ceci peut inclure :
• Concevoir une interface pour ajouter, modifier et réordonner les demandes d'un dossier, chacune avec son montant, son unité de calcul et son ordre
• Modéliser les dépendances entre demandes (une demande qui ne s'applique que si une autre est refusée par exemple)
• Calculer et afficher les montants (du coût pour l’employeur au net empoché par le salarié), pour aider l'utilisateur à évaluer les risques
• Générer automatiquement un document de synthèse clair et structuré, prêt à être intégré dans les conclusions écrites de l'avocat
• Et d'autres fonctionnalités !
Le ou la stagiaire participera à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit et les juristes) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Jobexit et participera également au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs fullstack de l’entreprise).
Les à-côtés du poste 👁️
Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :
• Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)
• Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus)
• Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins
## Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝
• Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
• Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
• Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
• Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.
## Nos valeurs 🤝
Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.
• Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
• Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
• Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
• Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
## Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️
🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.
🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles
🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne
🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers
📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise
🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être
🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an
👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan
🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)
💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal
🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple
## Notre processus de recrutement 🚀
• Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
• Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
• Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
• Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
(si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)
Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater !
Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.
Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature !
Diversité & inclusion
Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement.
Nous nous engageons à mettre en place tous les aménagements nécessaires pour garantir un environnement de travail adapté a chacun et chacune

title: Software Engineer - Dynamics
description:
Wanna join the adventure?
Loft Orbital is looking for a Software Engineer to join the Dynamics team within Ground Platform. Dynamics computes the timeline of what every spacecraft in our fleet can do and when (contacts with ground stations, links, accesses, unavailability windows) and turns it into schedules: which satellite talks to which ground station, when, and in which order of priority.
As our fleet grows, these services need to handle more data, more queries, and harder allocation problems. You’ll bring strong backend engineering to that challenge: making our APIs fast, our databases scale, and our contact allocation and scheduling smarter. No astrodynamics background is needed; you’ll work alongside flight dynamics engineers who bring that expertise.
If you enjoy hard performance problems and optimization with real-world constraints, we’d love to hear from you.
About this role:
• Build and optimize our scheduling capabilities: model constraints and objectives, design algorithms and solver-based approaches that produce feasible, high-quality schedules across a growing fleet, and replan quickly when things change
• Evolve contact allocation (Contact Allocation Framework) to share ground station capacity across satellites and missions
• Improve the performance of our backend services and APIs: profile, find bottlenecks and cut latency for the timeline and scheduling services that operators and other teams rely on
• Design and evolve our data layer for large, fast-growing time-based datasets: data modeling, partitioning, indexing, query optimization and retention
• Shape the architecture of Dynamics services for low latency and scale, in step with the rest of Ground Platform
• Collaborate with flight dynamics engineers, Mission Platform (Execution & Insights) and satellite operators to turn their needs into reliable, performant software
• Have the opportunity to take part in spacecraft operations through SatDevOps rotations, occasionally helping investigate anomalies
Must Haves:
• Solid backend software development experience, in Python
• Strong algorithmic foundations for scheduling and optimization problems: modeling constraints and objectives, heuristics, and knowing when to reach for a solver
• Proven track record improving the performance of APIs or backend services (profiling, caching, concurrency, load testing)
• Strong relational database skills, ideally PostgreSQL: data modeling, indexing, partitioning, reading query plans
• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
Nice to Haves:
• Experience with constraint programming or operations research (e.g. OR-Tools / CP-SAT, MILP solvers), or with scheduling and allocation problems
• Django and GraphQL (Graphene)
• Time-series or geospatial data at scale (e.g. TimescaleDB, PostGIS)
• Kubernetes and observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana)
• Interest in space (astrodynamics knowledge not required)
Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
• Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
• Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
• Health and life insurance, we care about your health
• Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
• Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
• Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
• Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
*Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.
Who We Are
Loft: Space Made Simple.
Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.
We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.
With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

title: Software Engineer, Agent
description:
## About us
Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.
We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.
Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.
## What you’ll do
Design and deliver production-grade AI agents: You'll build and ship highly performant, reliable, and intuitive AI agents that are central, mission-critical and drive revenue directly to Sierra's growth. These aren't prototypes—they are powerful, scalable systems running in production environments across industries like finance, healthcare, and commerce.
Drive the Agent Development Life Cycle (ADLC): You'll have complete ownership and autonomy from initial pilot through deployment and continuous iteration. You'll be responsible for building, tuning, and evolving AI agents in production environments, defining the standard for ADLC best practices along the way.
Partner with large enterprises and cutting-edge startups: You’ll work directly with leaders at some of the world’s largest enterprises to understand their most pressing business challenges, and build AI agents that transform how they operate at scale. You'll also partner with the most cutting-edge startups, embedding AI agents across their entire business stack to drive innovation and efficiency.
Build the future of the platform: Your direct work with customers will guide the evolution of Sierra's core platform. You'll surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform to shape the future of AI agent development and Sierra's product.
## Example projects
These are some examples of projects that engineers on our team have worked on recently:
Design and build AI agents for large telecommunications and media companies that consistently outperform human agents in managing subscription churn
Develop and refine AI agents capable of navigating complex customer interactions, like troubleshooting a broken device and personalising product recommendations
Create generalisable AI agent frameworks tailored for industry-specific use cases. See some examples in our financial services blog!
Facilitate design partnerships for new product initiatives, such as new agent architectures, self-service capabilities, and generative agent development
Experiment with the latest voice models and figure out how to integrate them at scale to enterprise-grade customers
## What you'll bring
Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems
Strong technical problem-solving skills, especially in fast-changing, ambiguous environments
A builder and tinkerer’s mindset with high agency - you find creative ways to overcome obstacles and ship
Comfort working directly with customers to understand their needs and solve real-world problems
Excellent communication skills - clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences
## Even better...
Experience building or deploying AI/LLM systems in production
Have been a founder or founding engineer - you know what it means to balance craft, ownership, and speed
Familiarity with tools that power today's AI agents: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering
Prior experience with React, TypeScript, and/or Go
Previous roles where you interfaced with customers or led technical projects with external stakeholders
## Our values
Trust: We do the right thing, even when no one is looking, and even when it’s hard. When we screw up, we take accountability, fully and completely. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud.
Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality.
Craftsmanship: A great company is the aggregation of thousands of things done well. As they say, “how you do anything is how you do everything”. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard.
Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.
Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We work hard, and turn on the afterburners when needed. But we pick up our parents at the airport when they’re visiting from out of town. We go to our kids’ events. And we show up for one another, in moments of celebration and hardship.
## What we offer
We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:
Flexible (unlimited) paid time off
Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family
Life insurance and disability benefits
Retirement plan dependent on country of employment
Parental leave
Fertility and family building benefits
Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite
Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most
Free alphorn lessons
These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.
## Be you, with us
We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply through the link on this page even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.
Sierra is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws, including veteran status and disability status. Hiring decisions are made by people, based on merit. If you need a reasonable accommodation for a disability, a religious practice, pregnancy or any related condition at any point in the application or interview process, contact us at ----- Requests are handled confidentially and do not affect your candidacy.

title: Internship - MLOps Engineer (January 2027)
description:
🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
 
- A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
- A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
- Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
- A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
 
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐
 
At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.


Explore your future career 🔭
We're looking for an MLOps Engineer Intern to join our MLOps team in Lyon for a 6-month internship starting January 2027. You'll report to Nicolas Mauti, our Staff MLOps, and sit at the heart of Malt's AI projects, where machine learning, software engineering, and infrastructure meet.
You'll have the opportunity to work on two fronts:
Product AI: Our ML Platform powers Malt's matching engine, the algorithm that pairs every client project with the right freelancer. It runs both in-house models and third-party models, including LLMs, and you'll help us train, deploy, serve, and monitor them in production with confidence.
Internal AI: Our agentic platform gives all employees across Malt the tools and infrastructure to build and run their own agents. You'll help develop and scale components such as our AI gateway (LLM, MCP, Skills registry), shared infrastructure, tracing, and observability (OpenTelemetry).
 
The two aren’t separate worlds. Much of what we do serves both, and ideally, so will your contributions.
 
What you build won’t sit in a notebook: it ships to production and is used every day by our ML engineers, hundreds of Malters, and our product’s hundreds of thousands of users.
Key responsibilities ✨
Speed up the path to production: Improve CI/CD and pipelines to cut the time from commit to production and remove friction for ML engineers.
Make model releases safer: Explore and implement better model testing and progressive rollouts such as canary deployments.
Keep production healthy: Proactively monitor our infrastructure and ML applications, build the missing alerts and dashboards, and propose fixes to reduce incidents.
Build our agentic platform: Contribute to the AI gateway, shared infrastructure, and tracing that let engineers across Malt build and run agents (both within the product and for internal usage).
Make teams autonomous: Automate and document the tooling you build so ML and product teams can use it on their own.
Collaborate across teams: Take part in code reviews, technical documentation, and team rituals with ML, Ops, and MLOps engineers.
About you 🧑‍🚀
