title: Business Systems Engineer – People Systems & AI Automation
description:
Who is Sonar?
Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position description
The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes, and we are building an AI-first approach to how Sonar runs its internal operations.
This role sits at the intersection of People operations, enterprise integration, and AI-driven automation. You will be the technical owner of Sonar’s People technology stack: our new global HR information system (HRIS), our recruiting and applicant tracking platform, time and attendance, performance and compensation tools, and the HR service desk in Jira Service Management. You will connect these systems to identity management, IT, finance, and our data warehouse, so that employee data is accurate, secure, and available wherever it is needed.
AI is a core part of the job. You will design and build AI assistants, agents, and automations that answer employee and manager questions, triage HR requests, support recruiters, and remove manual work across the employee lifecycle, always with the right controls for sensitive data. As Sonar grows, your scope will extend to further business applications in the BizTech portfolio.
Your success will give Sonar one trusted employee record, a seamless experience from candidate to new hire to alumni, and People teams who spend their time on people rather than on systems.
What you will do
You are confident in owning and evolving business applications for a fast-growing, multi-site, and multi-national organization. You combine hands-on platform administration with strong integration and data skills, and you treat AI as a practical tool to make systems smarter and processes lighter. As such, you bring proven, multi-year experience in:
• Own the administration, configuration, and security of our HRIS and related People tools, including roles, permissions, workflows, custom fields, and release management.
• Lead the implementation and phased rollout of our new HRIS together with the People team (Core HR, Time & Attendance, Performance, Compensation, and more), from requirements and design through testing, go-live, and hypercare.
• Lead data migration from legacy HR and time-off systems, including field mapping, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation.
• Own the technical side of our recruiting platform: job requisition and approval workflows, offer processes, candidate data retention, and integrations with the HRIS so a hired candidate becomes an employee record without manual re-entry.
• Design and run the HR service desk in Jira Service Management: request types, queues, SLAs, approvals, automation rules, and a knowledge base, so employees get fast, consistent answers and HR requests are tracked end to end.
• Automate joiner-mover-leaver processes end to end, from offer accepted through onboarding tickets, account provisioning, role changes, and offboarding, in partnership with IT Operations and Workplace teams.
• Design, build, and maintain integrations between People systems and identity management, IT service management, ERP, payroll, travel and expense, and the data warehouse, using APIs, webhooks, SCIM, and native connectors.
• Own the employee data model and make the HRIS the trusted source of truth for attributes such as department, cost center, manager, location, and title.
• Build AI assistants and agents for People processes, for example answering policy and benefits questions from the knowledge base, triaging and routing HR tickets, summarizing cases, and drafting job descriptions or interview materials for recruiters.
• Connect AI tools (such as Claude, Rovo, or Glean) to People systems through MCP and enterprise connectors, using least-privilege access, clear governance, and testing in sandbox before production.
• Identify automation opportunities across the employee lifecycle, prototype quickly, and turn what works into reliable, monitored, and documented production solutions.
• Ensure People systems meet data privacy (GDPR and other regional laws), access control, and ITGC requirements, including periodic access reviews and support for audits.
• Lead and document change management, maintain runbooks and architecture documentation, and provide training for People teams and end users.
Experience and qualifications
• Proven experience (5+ years) administering a modern cloud HRIS (e.g. HiBob, Workday, BambooHR, Personio, or similar) in a multi-country environment, including at least one implementation or migration
• Experience administering an applicant tracking system (e.g. Lever, Greenhouse, or Ashby), including requisition and offer workflows and ATS-to-HRIS integration
• Hands-on experience configuring Jira Service Management or a similar service desk tool (e.g. ServiceNow HRSD, Zendesk) for HR or IT: request types, queues, SLAs, automation, and knowledge base
• Strong experience building integrations with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON, using middleware or iPaaS tools (e.g. Workato, Make, or AWS Lambda); scripting in Python or JavaScript is a plus
• Hands-on experience building with AI: LLM assistants, agents, MCP, prompt-based workflows, or AI features in enterprise tools (e.g. Claude, Rovo, Glean). You have shipped something real, not just experimented
• Understanding of responsible AI use with personal data: access controls, data minimization, human review, and avoiding bias in recruiting and HR decisions
• Solid data skills: data modeling, migration, reporting, and SQL; experience feeding a data warehouse is a plus
• Good understanding of HR processes across the employee lifecycle: recruiting, onboarding, Core HR, time off, performance, compensation, and offboarding
• Experience with SSO and automated user provisioning (SCIM) to an identity provider (e.g. JumpCloud, Okta, or Microsoft Entra ID)
• Experience handling sensitive employee data under GDPR and supporting ITGC or external audits
• A plus: HRIS or Atlassian certifications (e.g. ACP-620 Jira Service Management), ITIL Foundation, or payroll integration experience (e.g. ADP)
• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field
• Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
• Effective communication and interpersonal skills
• Highly autonomous and pragmatic
• Open-minded and very positive can-do attitude
• Prefer to work in a team, share information, and ideas and understand the power of collective thinking to get the best solutions
• Comfortable in dealing with change and complexity
• Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo as well as to receive and give feedback to improve the team and yourself
• Leadership: Taking the initiative and demonstrating your ability to lead a subject from beginning to end
• Valuing “done” over “perfect”
In-office culture
We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 
Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.
 
We value diversity, equity, and inclusion
At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com. 
All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 
Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

Operating as a “day‑one” builder, the Gen AI Engineer designs and delivers data pipelines that bridge legacy on‑premise systems—including mainframes, SQL Server, and DB2—with modern cloud platforms such as Snowflake and AWS/Azure AI ecosystems. The role ensures that data is not merely transferred, but deliberately engineered to meet the statistical, performance, and governance requirements of model training, inference, and RAG‑based AI systems.
## Remote role, open to any U.S. state.

• Designs, builds, and maintains resilient ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from on‑premise systems, AWS services (S3, RDS), and Azure platforms (Blob Storage, Azure SQL), centralizing and curating data for consumption in Snowflake and downstream AI services.
• Develops and maintains feature stores and analytically optimized datasets that support machine learning workflows, ensuring data is clean, versioned, reproducible, and statistically valid for Data Science teams.
• Engineers data pipelines that enable generative AI use cases, including the automated extraction, transformation, chunking, and loading of structured and unstructured data into vector databases across AWS and Azure environments.
• Acts as a Snowflake power user and technical lead, implementing advanced data modeling patterns, Snowpipe automation, and compute and storage optimization to support high‑concurrency analytics and AI workloads.
• Executes non‑invasive data extraction strategies to unlock mission‑critical data from decades‑old legacy systems while preserving system stability and avoiding disruption to core business operations.
• Designs and manages complex, cross‑platform data workflows using orchestration tools such as Airflow, AWS Step Functions, and Azure Data Factory to ensure reliable, synchronized data movement across the organization’s multi‑cloud architecture.
• Partners closely with central IT, database administrators, infrastructure, and security teams to resolve connectivity and access challenges—including PrivateLink, IAM, network segmentation, and firewall controls—while securing production approval for new data integrations.
• Implements automated data quality, validation, and observability frameworks to detect data drift, anomalies, and integrity issues that could negatively impact production analytics, machine learning, or AI systems.
• Drives efficiency across the data ecosystem by optimizing storage, compute usage, and query performance in Snowflake, AWS, and Azure, ensuring responsible cost management and measurable ROI for Transformation Office initiatives.
• Operates as a dedicated engineering partner to MLOps, Data Science, and AI teams, rapidly iterating on evolving data requirements and translating experimental use cases into scalable, production‑ready data solutions.
## ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES
• Performs other duties as assigned.
• Travel as required.
## QUALIFICATIONS
## Education & Licensing

Source is an ecosystem of independent technology companies behind responsible access to web data. Source works behind the scenes, providing shared standards and dedicated support that help each company grow.
The culture follows the same idea: colleagues work across the ecosystem, share what they know, and hold a high bar, so a good idea in one place can create an advantage everywhere.
## The team waiting for you:
The Security team protects our people, infrastructure, products, and customer data. As a Security Engineer, you will own our cloud security posture and detection and response capability, working side by side with platform and product engineers to make the secure way the default way. Our infrastructure and engineering organisation are growing rapidly, and we are moving from manual reviews to security guardrails, detections, and automation built as code. This role directly reduces the likelihood and impact of a breach – you will be the person who spots the misconfiguration before an attacker does and leads the response when something goes wrong.
## In this role, you will:
• Continuously harden the security posture of our GCP environment, managing IAM, organisation policies, networking, KMS, and secrets management.
• Triage cloud security findings via Wiz and collaborate directly with platform and product teams to drive remediation and meet SLAs for critical vulnerabilities.
• Build and maintain detection and response capabilities, including log pipelines into Elasticsearch, detection rules, alert triage, and incident response.
• Automate security guardrails as code using Terraform, policy-as-code frameworks, and GitLab CI checks.
• Manage and scale SIEM/SOC systems and other security tooling, supporting platform teams during deployment and onboarding.
• Oversee vulnerability management for infrastructure, hosts, and container images, tracking open risks and driving follow-ups to completion.
## Your skills & experience:
• 3+ years of experience in security engineering, cloud security, or an SRE/DevOps role with a strong security focus.
• Hands-on expertise securing major public cloud environments (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable), specifically encompassing IAM, networking, logging, and KMS.
• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and scripting or automation (Python, Go, or Bash).
• Practical experience in detection and incident response, including working with SIEM platforms, writing detection rules, and handling real-world security incidents.
• Solid foundational knowledge in Linux, networking, containerisation, and Kubernetes security, paired with a pragmatic, risk-based approach to problem-solving and cross-team collaboration.
## Nice to Have:
• Experience with GKE/Kubernetes hardening and admission control (OPA Gatekeeper, Kyverno).
• Familiarity with CSPM/CNAPP tools (Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Security Command Center).
• Detection engineering experience in Elastic Security / ES|QL.
• Exposure to ISO 27001, SOC 2, or PCI DSS controls.
• Certifications such as GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CKS, or OSCP.
## Tech stack:
• GCP (GKE, IAM, Cloud Logging, KMS, Secret Manager)
• Terraform, GitLab CI/CD
• Wiz (CSPM / container scanning)
• Elasticsearch / Elastic Security
• Python / Go / Bash
• Jira, Confluence, Slack

title: Full Stack Web & eCommerce Engineer
description:
## Join the ACI Learning Adventure!
## Our Mission
Welcome to a new era of learning, where individuals and organizations come to transform goals into measurable success. At ACI Learning, we believe that anything worth doing is worth leading the way—with innovation, exceptional experiences, and impactful results.
We provide a full ecosystem of learning and development solutions that empower people and businesses to lead with confidence, learn with purpose, and achieve outcomes that matter. Join us, and together, we'll shape the future of skill-building and professional growth.
## The ACI Team
Imagine collaborating with over 200 of the brightest minds who are passionate, grounded, and dedicated to shaping the future of eLearning. Together, we're not just a team; we're a movement in one of the most exciting times in tech.
## Purpose-Driven Culture
At ACI Learning, work isn’t just a job. It’s a passion we pour into every project, every day. We celebrate creativity, innovation, and the joy of doing what we love.
## Your Opportunity
Are you ready to be part of something transformative? Dive into a world of collaboration, growth, and endless potential. Apply now and help lead the change!
## Who We Are
ACI Learning is a leading provider of audit, cybersecurity and IT training solutions, empowering individuals and organizations worldwide to improve their technical capabilities and their cybersecurity with compelling and comprehensive training. Our leadership position extends even further to our new SaaS Learning Platform myACI that goes beyond audit, cyber and IT training to provide organizational and individual knowledge assessment, analytics and training delivery with integrated AI to understand capabilities and skill gaps for organizations.
## Full Stack Web & eCommerce Engineer
## Remote (US) | Full-Time | Exempt
From the first click through checkout, our websites shape how learners and businesses find, evaluate, and buy from ACI Learning. You’ll improve and extend every step of that buyer journey. You’ll work directly with the Director of Web on a small team, and your work ties straight to revenue and to organic and AI-search visibility.
## What you’ll do
You’ll be the hands-on engineer behind everything a buyer touches on our sites, from the first search result to the order confirmation. Day to day, that means shipping new features, keeping a growing stack healthy, and building the systems that let a small team do more. The Director of Web sets direction and priorities. You own the technical decisions and the quality of what ships, from Figma through production, across acilearning.com, acitechacademy.com, and our headless BigCommerce store.
## Storefront and checkout
• Lead day-to-day development of our headless ecommerce storefront (Next.js / React on Vercel), including cart and checkout, and contribute to product experiences for Commercial, Consumer, and Academic buyers
• Build a new Academic checkout channel for ACI Skill Labs with the Director of Web, from design through launch
• Instrument and test ecommerce analytics, user insights, and conversion improvements
## Marketing sites and SEO
• Develop and maintain our marketing sites (React / Gatsby with a headless CMS), including a new /learn/ knowledge base
• Implement technical SEO and AI-search readiness: structured data, crawlability, and fixes for errors that hurt rankings
## Content automation
• Build AI-assisted pipelines with the team that pull news and course content, draft into our headless CMS (Strapi v5) for human review, and publish to the site and search
• Set up on-demand or incremental builds so time-sensitive pages go live without a full site rebuild
## Integrations
• Maintain the Node middleware and APIs that send order, customer, and product data from our storefront to HubSpot, Stripe, and our CRM, and understand what happens downstream in our ERP, provisioning, and learning platform
• Partner with Product on integrations such as SSO, catalog sync, and provisioning
## Platform health and design system
• Keep the stack current, secure, and lean: framework and dependency upgrades, patching, Core Web Vitals, and tech debt (refactoring legacy code, consolidating duplicate components, removing unused dependencies, and improving build times and bundle size)
• Design and build UI from concept to Figma to production, and build our design system: design tokens, a shared React component library that matches our Figma components, and documented patterns that keep every site consistent
• Document what you build so the team isn’t dependent on any one person
## How you’ll work
• Scope and ship work independently, with a weekly check-in with the Director of Web
• Pair with teammates and take on work outside your lane when the team needs it, from a copy fix to a checkout bug
• Explain technical trade-offs to marketing, Product, and leadership, in writing and in meetings
• Track how your work affects conversion, traffic, and checkout completion
## How we use AI
We use AI tools like Claude and Cursor every day to build skills and move faster, not to stand in for your own understanding or judgment. In practice, that means you:
• Can explain every line you ship, whether you wrote it or an AI tool drafted it
• Review, test, and debug AI-generated code with the same rigor as your own
• Know when to use an AI tool and when it’s faster or safer to work it through yourself
• Use AI to learn unfamiliar code and systems and to raise the bar on documentation, testing, and code quality, and help shape how the team uses it
## What you’ll need
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Human-Computer Interaction, Design, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, such as a coding bootcamp, relevant certifications, or shipped work you can show us
• 5+ years of professional full stack web development, with production sites you can walk us through
• React and TypeScript code you’ve shipped to production, including at least one Next.js site and one other React framework or static site generator (Gatsby or similar)
• js APIs and third-party integrations you’ve built and run in production (REST / GraphQL, webhooks, auth)
• Experience integrating a storefront or web app with CRM, ERP, or payment systems (HubSpot, Stripe, or similar)
• At least one ecommerce cart or checkout flow you’ve shipped, including payments and the edge cases that come with them
• At least one production site on a headless architecture: headless commerce or a headless CMS (Strapi preferred, Contentful, Sanity or similar), including content models you designed
## What we’d like you to have
## Design and front end
• A portfolio of interfaces you designed in Figma and then built in code
• A design system you’ve built or extended: tokens, a coded component library (Storybook or similar), and documentation that designers and developers both use
• Technical SEO fixes you’ve shipped: semantic HTML, structured data / schema.org, page speed, or crawlability
## Commerce, data, and platforms
• BigCommerce Catalyst: building on BigCommerce’s headless Next.js storefront and its APIs
• HubSpot work you’ve shipped: custom objects or properties, forms, workflows, or HubSpot API integrations, such as syncing ecommerce or website data into HubSpot
• GA4 and Google Tag Manager, ecommerce event tracking, and A/B tests or behavior analysis (such as Microsoft Clarity) that changed what you shipped
• Owned deployments and environments on modern hosting (Vercel, Netlify, Render, or similar) and Git-based workflows
• A refactor or cleanup you’ve led in an existing codebase, and what it improved
## AI, search, and media
• A project or experiment where you applied AI to how software gets built or how people find information (AI search, LLM citations)
• Scheduled jobs or workflows that call LLM APIs (such as the Claude API), with human review built in
• Algolia or a similar search platform you’ve implemented or tuned
• Work with video platforms (such as JW Player) and their APIs for clips, captions, and transcripts
## Background
• Time on a marketing-site or growth team, not only application development
At ACI Learning, we offer a competitive, experience-driven salary range that aligns with your qualifications and contributions. To that end, the posted salary range reflects our most reasonable assumption of pay for this position at the time of posting.
Pay range
$105,500—$123,500 USD
## Why ACI Learning is Your Next Big Move
For Full-Time, Benefits Eligible Positions
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage—starting the 1st of the month after your hire date.
Four weeks of paid parental or medical leave, so you can focus on what matters most.
Flexible PTO policy, sick time, and eight paid holidays — because we believe in balance.
401(k) retirement plan so you can invest in your future from day one.
One free course each year after 90 days — advancing your skills is part of the job.
Tuition assistance to support your continued education and professional growth.

title: Research Engineer, AI (Entry-Level)
description:
## Company Overview
Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.
We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.
## Job Summary
Support applied research across the Orbis AI focus areas — agentic AI, knowledge representation, dynamic ontologies, autonomous analysis, and high-performance analytics — working alongside senior research engineers on questions with real product stakes. You will reproduce baselines, build evaluation datasets and harnesses, run experiments, and write up what actually happened. This role exists to bring strong early-career engineers into applied AI research and grow them toward owning a research area.
Travel: Occasional, up to 10%, for conferences, training, and team collaboration.
## Key Responsibilities
• Reproduce baselines and published methods, and document precisely where your results diverge from what was reported.
• Build and maintain evaluation datasets and harnesses, including cases that capture known failure modes.
• Run experiments designed with senior research engineers, keeping records complete enough that someone else can rerun them.
• Perform error analysis — characterize what the system got wrong and why, and report it without smoothing it over.
• Implement well-scoped prototype components with design direction and code review from senior engineers.
• Summarize relevant literature and open-source work, and explain how it bears on the question at hand.
• Write up results, negative results included, and present them in team research reviews.
• Travel occasionally, up to 10%, for conferences, training, and team collaboration.
## Required Qualifications
• 0-2 years of professional experience
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated ability
• Solid programming fundamentals in Python, with code you can walk us through and defend
• Working understanding of machine learning and LLM fundamentals — evaluation basics, prompting, embeddings, and retrieval — from coursework, projects, internships, or professional work
• Ability to read a technical paper and explain what it claims, how it was evaluated, and where it might not hold
• Intellectual honesty about results, including the ones that undercut a hypothesis you liked
• Willingness to travel occasionally, up to 10%
## Desired Qualifications
• Research experience from a thesis, lab, internship, or open-source project
• Hands-on project experience with retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, or fine-tuning
• Exposure to graph databases, ontologies, or information extraction
• Experience with experiment tracking and evaluation tooling such as notebooks, dataset construction, or scoring pipelines
• Exposure to containerized environments (Docker) and cloud or GPU compute
• Interest in OSINT, intelligence, or investigative research workflows
## Physical Requirements
• Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
• Participation in virtual and in-person meetings
• Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions
Travel: Occasional, up to 10%, for conferences, training, and team collaboration.
## Orbis Benefits
Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.
Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.
## Orbis Locations
Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.
Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.
Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.
Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, and we make employment decisions based on merit,
qualifications, and business need. Orbis does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.
Orbis complies with all applicable equal opportunity and non-discrimination laws in every jurisdiction in which we operate. Reasonable accommodation is available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.

title: Compiler Engineer - Machine Learning Compiler
description:
About us
Mythic is building the future of AI computing with breakthrough analog technology that delivers 100× the performance of traditional digital systems at the same power and cost. This unlocks bigger, more capable models and faster, more responsive applications—whether in edge devices like drones, robotics, and sensors, or in cloud and data center environments. Our technology powers everything from large language models and CNNs to advanced signal processing, and is engineered to operate from –40 °C to +125 °C, making it ideal for industrial, automotive, aerospace, and defense.
We’ve raised over $100M from world-class investors including Softbank, Threshold Ventures, Lux Capital, and DCVC, and secured multi-million-dollar customer contracts across multiple markets.
About the role
Join us in building the next generation of AI compilers. You’ll play a key role in developing the compiler for our novel AI accelerator, working side-by-side with hardware engineers and ML researchers. Your work will shape how deep learning workloads run on cutting-edge dataflow hardware—defining the instruction set, execution model, and developer experience. The result: a compiler that delivers breakthrough performance while remaining seamless and intuitive for ML developers.
## Here's what you will do
• Contribute across the full compiler stack, including operator lowering, graph/IR transformations, optimization passes, and backend code generation
• Optimize for dataflow architectures, developing pipelined schedules, memory orchestration, and resource-constrained execution strategies
• Collaborate with hardware architects to influence architectural features, ensuring the compiler and hardware evolve together
• Develop compilation strategies that unify our analog compute with digital subsystems
• Build and maintain a compiler that produces high-performance binaries with strong debugging support, clear error messages, and predictable performance models
## Here's the background we hope you will have
• 3+ years of experience building compilers or high-performance systems software, especially those involving complex resource management or optimization.
• Expert in modern C++ (C++14/17/20) and strong Python.
• Experience with compiler IRs (SSA-based or graph-based), transformations, and code generation
• Exposure to specialized accelerators (GPU, NPU, FPGA, or custom ASIC) or parallel architectures
## The following would be nice to have, but is not required
• Experience with machine learning compiler stacks (e.g., ONNX, MLIR, TVM, XLA, IREE, PyTorch), with contributions to MLIR or LLVM projects a plus
• Experience with optimization methods (LP/MIP, CP, SAT/SMT) using solvers like Gurobi or OR-Tools for scheduling and resource allocation
• Experience compiling for specialized accelerators (GPU, NPU, FPGA, or custom ASIC) on DNN workloads; GPU/DSP experience is valuable if combined with compiler backend work beyond kernel tuning
• Familiarity with heterogeneous compilation, especially mixing custom accelerators with CPUs/GPUs/NPUs, and exposure to analog or in-memory compute is a plus
• Experience collaborating in compiler–hardware co-design (architecture + ISA) for better compiler usability and hardware efficiency
## What we offer
• The opportunity to shape how deep learning and LLM workloads are compiled on novel hardware.
• A role that spans software and hardware co-design, shaping both the compiler and the accelerator architecture
• A collaborative, innovative team that values engineering rigor, continuous integration, and user-focused design. We foster an environment of shared learning and technical excellence
• Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits package
## Compensation
## Additional Information
At Mythic, we foster a collaborative and respectful environment where people can do their best work. We hire smart, capable individuals, provide the tools and support they need, and trust them to deliver. Our team brings a wide range of experiences and perspectives, which we see as a strength in solving hard problems together. We value professionalism, creativity, and integrity, and strive to make Mythic a place where every employee feels they belong and can contribute meaningfully.

description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
## Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced, highly technical and customer-centric Forward Deployed Engineer - DevOps/SRE to join our Customer Success team. In this role, you will play a crucial role as a technical solution expert and advisor working closely with some of the largest Harness AppSec customers to design, implement and optimize Harness platform and adoption strategies to ensure they realize maximum value and outcomes.
Our team is small, collaborative, and deeply motivated — we work at the intersection of technology, security, and business, and we bring curiosity and rigor to a wide range of challenges. You will have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a rapidly growing company while helping customers harness the power of our AI-enabled DevSecOps platform to build and deliver software securely and efficiently — including protecting AI applications from emerging threats.
We prioritize psychological safety, mentorship, and continuous learning. Whether you're coming from engineering, architecture, consulting, or security — we want to hear from you.
## About the role
• Serve as the primary technical owner of customer implementations and adoption programs across the Harness AppSec portfolio, developing deep familiarity with each customer's environment, goals, and success criteria
• Provide hands-on technical guidance and consulting to customers throughout the customer lifecycle, from onboarding and implementation to adoption and value realization.
• Develop strategic account success plans to ensure successful operationalization and value realization and drive alignment with all levels of customer leadership.
• Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Harness platform and AppSec modules as well as general skillset across AI applications and security, DevOps, SecOps, application security, cloud architectures, networks and infrastructure disciplines and industry trends to effectively support, educate and advise customers.
• Proactively analyze customer usage data to surface trends, adoption gaps, and optimization opportunities — delivering actionable recommendations across technology, process, and people dimensions.
• Bring constructive feedback from customers to product management to improve the solution, and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, product, and engineering, to drive the successful adoption, integration, and ongoing optimization of our solution.
• Conduct regular business reviews and check-ins with customers to ensure their ongoing success and satisfaction, addressing any concerns or issues in a timely and effective manner.
• Proactively identify at-risk accounts by performing churn and adoption analysis to ensure target product adoption and business (AGRR) goals are met.
• Contribute to the development and refinement of customer success processes, tools, and resources to continuously improve the efficiency and effectiveness of our customer success delivery methodologies and collateral.
• Participate in Harness Community forums and help build reference architectures, best-practice guides, and enablement content
## About you
• 7+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, technical consulting, security engineering, or technical account management within the software or technology industry.
• 5+ years of experience with some multiple of the following solutions preferred:
• Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Azure, Terraform, CloudFormation, Linux
• Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes, Helm, Kustomize, OpenShift, PCF
• CI/CD & DevOps: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Harness Pipelines, Jira, ServiceNow.
• Languages & Scripting: Python, Bash, YAML, Go (a plus).
• Application Security: SAST, DAST, SCA, IAST, SBOM generation, API security testing, pen testing fundamentals, SIEM (Splunk, Datadog), SOAR platforms.
• Prior experience in security engineering and architecture, application security, API and AI security, development, DevOps, SecOps, or web security is preferred.
• Ability to quickly learn, understand, and work with new emerging technologies and solutions in the AI, DevOps, Cloud and Security space.
• Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and relationship-building skills, with a proven ability to manage complex customer relationships and communicate business and technical value to all levels of management.
• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to quickly diagnose and resolve technical issues.
• Detail-oriented and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with a strong commitment to continuous learning and growth.
• Bachelor's degree in a related field, such as Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering is preferred
## Must Have Skills
• Kubernetes eco system expertise (k8s, helm, release, upgrade, troubleshooting etc)
• In depth Cloud experience - AWS is a must (GCP, Azure good to have) - infra provisioning, VPC++ ,EKS, S3, EBS ,EFS, EC2 etc
• Linux ecosystem
• Troubleshooting skills for the above
• Programming (Scripting) experience along with ability to write custom integrations or tailored
Pay transparency
$180,000—$202,000 USD

• How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
• Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

description:
## About Supabase
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.
## About the Role
We are seeking a platform engineer to join our Compute Capacity team. This team owns the capacity plan that keeps compute supply ahead of demand across every region we operate in — the forecasting, buffer policy, and provisioning systems that make sure a project never runs into a wall it didn't know was there.
You'll work on the systems that turn a capacity plan into provisioned reality: reservation acquisition, fleet reconciliation, and the automation that keeps what we've committed to in sync with what we're actually running. You'll help build the metrics and alerting that let capacity problems surface months out, on vendor lead time, rather than at the moment someone needs the room.
You'll design, build, and operate systems that are both robust and highly automated — helping us hold the right buffer at the right cost, catch drift before it becomes a shortage, and give every team a single, trustworthy view of how much room we have across the millions of databases we manage.
## What You'll Be Responsible For
Help build and maintain the capacity plan that keeps Supabase's compute supply ahead of demand across regions and instance families
Support buffer policy by modeling headroom targets and their cost tradeoffs for review and sign-off
Build and maintain automation that turns the capacity plan into provisioned reality — reservation acquisition and top-up, fleet reconciliation, drift detection between committed and running capacity
Extend our infrastructure as code for capacity-relevant provisioning
Instrument capacity: build and maintain metrics for saturation, reservation coverage, idle buffer, forecast error, and provisioning latency
Build and tune capacity alerting so headroom, quota, and reservation issues surface months out rather than at the moment of impact
Support the demand gate — helping intake large customer commitments, launches, migrations, and new regions so they reach the plan before they reach the fleet
Contribute to mitigation projects: right-sizing, instance-family migrations, autoscaling improvements, workload consolidation
Help drive down compute cost per database through right-sizing, placement, and commitment coverage work
Participate in capacity incident response and post-incident follow-through
## You Might Be A Good Fit If You
Have 5+ years across infrastructure engineering, SRE, platform, or capacity engineering, ideally at SaaS or cloud infrastructure scale
Have production software engineering experience — you've owned and operated a service, not just a notebook. Comfortable in modern languages like TypeScript, Python, and Go
Are comfortable working against forecasts and assumptions that are incomplete, and can revise your work as those assumptions change
Have experience with Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi or Terraform)
Have built or maintained observability for systems you own — metrics that answer real questions and alerting people trust (Prometheus/Grafana, CloudWatch, or similar);
Have solid working knowledge of AWS EC2: instance families and generations, purchase options, capacity reservations, and quota mechanics
Have some financial fluency — you understand reservation economics and the basic tradeoffs between coverage, utilization, and cost
Communicate clearly across audiences, from engineers to finance stakeholders

Fully Remote

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.
Professional Development
Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

With over a billion people using the service and more than fifty offices around the globe, a career at Meta offers countless ways to make an impact in a fast growing organization.
Meta is seeking Research Scientist Interns to join the Agent for Recommendation team within Facebook. Our recommendation systems help billions of people discover content every day on products such as Facebook Reels and Feed. We build AI agents for recommendation that work alongside researchers and engineers to analyze data, develop models, debug issues, run experiments, and decide what to launch.
A key direction is recursive self-improvement (RSI): closing the loop so that agents propose, test, and learn from improvements to production models, and get better at it with every iteration. This raises open research questions in agent reasoning and planning, grounding in domain knowledge and code, idea generation, memory and learning from feedback, evaluation, and human-AI collaboration, on frontier systems such as large-scale generative recommenders.
Interns will own one focused research problem at the intersection of LLM agents, machine learning, and recommender systems, selected based on their expertise and team priorities. They will build and evaluate solutions on production-scale systems, with a path to both product impact and publication.
Our internships are twelve (12) to sixteen (16), or twenty-four (24) weeks long and we have various start dates throughout the year.
## Responsibilities
• Perform research to advance agentic AI and its application to large-scale recommender systems
• Design, build, and evaluate LLM-based agents for recommendation, such as agents that analyze data and experiments, diagnose issues, or develop and tune models
• Advance self-improvement loops in which agents propose, run, and learn from experiments, with people reviewing key decisions
• Develop methods that make agents reliable, such as grounding in domain knowledge and code, planning and tool use, memory, and learning from feedback
• Build rigorous evaluation for agents, including benchmarks, metrics, and measurement of real product impact
• Collaborate with researchers, engineers, and cross-functional partners, and communicate research plans, progress, and results
• Publish research results and contribute to research that can be applied to Meta product development
## Minimum Qualifications
• Currently has or is in the process of obtaining a Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, or a related technical field
• Experience with Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch
• Experience conducting research in machine learning, recommender systems, large language models or agents, or reinforcement learning
• Experience designing experiments, analyzing results, and communicating technical findings
## Preferred Qualifications
• Intent to return to the degree program after the completion of the internship/co-op
• Proven track record of research achievements as demonstrated by publications at leading venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, RecSys, WWW, SIGIR, ACL, or EMNLP
• Research or project experience in LLM agents and tool use, reasoning and planning, automated machine learning, AI for research, reinforcement learning, or Bayesian optimization
• Expertise in recommender systems, ranking, relevance, or personalization, such as generative recommendation, sequential modeling, retrieval, or learning to rank
• Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to redesign workflows and drive measurable impact, and to stay current with emerging AI technologies (e.g., context engineering, agent orchestration)
• Experience working and communicating cross-functionally in a fast-paced team environment

Our research brings together large language models, computer vision, generative modeling, and reinforcement learning to understand content and user preferences and generate personalized recommendations.

title: Research Fellow / Research Associate (Fluid dynamics simulation and AI)
description:
The School of Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering (MAE) is a robust, dynamic and multi-disciplinary international research community comprising of world-class scientists and bright students. MAE prides itself in its excellent research capabilities in areas including advanced manufacturing, aerospace, biomedical, energy, industrial engineering, maritime engineering, robotics, etc. The school is equipped with state-of-the-art research infrastructure, housing a comprehensive range of cluster laboratories, test bedding facilities, research centres/institutes and corporate laboratories. Cutting-edge research in MAE addresses the immediate needs of our industries and supports the nation’s long-term development strategies. In the new era of industrial 4.0 and sustainable living, MAE is rigorous in developing new competencies to support the growth and competitiveness of our engineering sector in the global landscape. MAE has grown to be leader in Engineering Research, ranking amongst the top engineering schools in the world.
For more details, please view https://www.ntu.edu.sg/mae/research.
The School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering (MAE) is seeking to hire a Research Fellow / Research Associate to lead the development of next-generation computational tools for simulating particle-laden two-phase flows by integrating advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques with traditional computational fluid dynamics (CFD) methods. The role focuses on transitioning legacy CFD solvers to modern, Python-based AI frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, JAX), targeting high-efficiency, scalable simulations of water-air systems with solid particle transport. The successful candidate will contribute to the creation of an AI-optimized platform capable of achieving up to 50× speedups in simulation performance, enabling real-time, energy-efficient modelling for complex multiscale flow phenomena relevant to coastal engineering, turbomachinery, and additive manufacturing. This position is central to advancing AI-augmented fluid dynamics and delivering an open, sustainable simulation tool for the research and engineering community.
Key Responsibilities:
Development of AI-augmented CFD frameworks
Simulation of turbulent flows
Design optimization for engineering system such as heat sinks, wind turbines et al.
Valid the numerical model with experimental or existing numerical work
Publish high-impact research
Engage in interdisciplinary collaboration
Job Requirements:
Education qualifications:
PhD or Master in Mechanical Engineering, Computational Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
Soft skills:
Critical thinking and problem-solving,
Collaboration and teamwork,
Good communication,
Time management and self-motivation
Hard skills:
Strong foundation in CFD,
Programming proficiency such as Python, AI/ML techniques,
Experience with parallel computing on CPU/GPU cluster,
use of CUDA, MPI is a plus.
Experience
Experience with open-source CFD frameworks (e.g., OpenFOAM, Basilisk, or similar) is advantageous,
Demonstrated track record of peer-reviewed publications in relevant fields.
Competencies
Capable of proposing and implementing novel computational strategies that go beyond traditional CFD paradigms,
Enthusiastic about exploring new AI paradigms and applying them to engineering challenges.
We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
